page.layout: One printed page. Left margin: three marginal notes, each beside a year block. Centre: a single table of consuls, one block per year (1408 to 1415), with the years in a right-hand column. Below the table: the catchword "Conradt" at the right. Running head at top centre, page number at top left.

main_text.l: Hisco Præpos. Emdanus Groningam venit patria ejectus.Jarch Coppens. | 1412
Seditio cruenta Groningæ, duce Coppeno Jargæo.Johan Rengers. | 1413
Keno Broeckmerius cum exulibus Groningam capit, ejicisque Sciringios.Berent Hornekinck. | {*}1415

page.notes: The "*" beside 1415 is a reference mark printed in the year column and is keyed to the left margin note. The asterisk in the margin is set in the same type. The years are printed in old-style figures (1408 to 1415). The table has no printed heading. Names in the table are given as printed; initial I is rendered as J where it stands for a consonant (Jarch, Johan, Jacob, Jargæo, Jarichs). The page carries no other printed text.
